companyFaqDesc: Which colors and sizes can I enquire about?
Color options include Black / Brown, Black, Black / Grey, with size labels 36-48. Confirm the size chart, fit and availability for your requested mix before ordering; no EU/US conversion is assumed.
What information is needed for a quotation?

Send the color and size mix, pair quantity, packaging requirements and destination. Listed prices are product references; freight, applicable taxes and additional order services are confirmed separately.
Which specifications should be confirmed before an order?

Confirm the requested style, material specifications, color and size mix, quantity, packaging and any sample requirements. Product-specific details and availability are checked before the order is confirmed.
Can I enquire about samples and custom branding?
Send your color, size, logo artwork and packaging brief. Sample availability, customization feasibility, costs and timing are reviewed for this style before confirmation.
When will the order be dispatched?
Dispatch depends on availability, order quantity, size mix and packing requirements. Timing is confirmed for each order before proceeding.
